question: What range of existence, from Śiva to the gods, is established in that reality?
premises: The range extends to the gods
All of it is situated there
inference: Everything from Śiva down to the gods is established in that same reality.
uncertainties: adevaparyantaṃ is read contextually as extending to the level of gods
plain_english: From Śiva onward up to the gods, all is situated there indeed.
